style.es: Tú, neutral Latin American vocabulary (archivo, computadora, celular; agregar rather than añadir). Sentence case. Decimal comma in prose numbers (1,5 MB) but code stays code.
style.pt-BR: Você, Brazilian vocabulary (arquivo, celular, baixar, excluir, tela). Sentence case.
style.fr: Vous. Sentence case. Use the plain ASCII apostrophe ('), and a normal space before : ; ? ! is fine. Use 'appareil', 'navigateur', 'télécharger' (download), 'envoyer' (upload).
style.de: Sie. Compound nouns as Germans write them (PDF-Datei, Seitenzahlen). Keep buttons short; Wird verarbeitet … style for progress. Avoid 'Download' as a noun on buttons: Herunterladen.
style.id: Anda. Common Indonesian tech words where people use them (file, browser, server, download in prose may be 'unduh'). Avoid stiff formal wording; avoid English except established terms.
style.it: Tu (informale ma pulito). Sentence case. Termini tech italiani diffusi: file, browser, server, dispositivo, scaricare (download), caricare (upload); virgola decimale nei numeri in prosa (1,5 MB), il codice resta codice.
style.tr: Siz (resmî ama sıcak), Türkiye Türkçesi (dosya, tarayıcı, cihaz, parola, indir, yükle); sentence case, düğmeler kısa ve emir kipinde (İndir, Kopyala); ilerleme için İşleniyor… biçimi; ekleri kesme işaretiyle yazın (PDF'e, JPG'ye).
style.vi: Bạn (second person, friendly but not chatty); use 'tệp' for file, 'trình duyệt', 'máy chủ', 'tải lên/tải xuống', keep established English tech terms (watermark, metadata, hash, regex, server in compounds like PPPoE server) and sentence case; Vietnamese uses the digit-group dot and decimal comma (1,5 MB) in prose but code stays code.
style.ru: Вы (строчная), нейтральный технический русский: скачать, загрузить, файл, браузер, устройство; заглавная буква только в начале фразы, устоявшиеся русские термины вместо англицизмов, кавычки-ёлочки, десятичная запятая (1,5 МБ).
style.pl: Forma bezpośrednia z małą literą (Twoje pliki, Ty) lub bezosobowo tam, gdzie brzmi to naturalnie; sentence case; polskie terminy tam, gdzie są powszechne (plik, przeglądarka, serwer, przesyłać, pobierz), a angielskie nazwy własne i protokoły bez zmian; przecinek dziesiętny w liczbach (1,5 MB), spacja jako separator tysięcy.
style.hi: आप (सम्मानजनक, सहज हिंदी); देवनागरी में लिखें, पर PDF, फ़ाइल, ब्राउज़र, सर्वर, डिवाइस जैसे प्रचलित तकनीकी शब्द वैसे ही रखें जैसे भारतीय टेक साइटें लिखती हैं; भारी शुद्ध हिंदी (संगणक, अभिगोपन) से बचें; संख्याएँ लैटिन अंकों में, दशमलव के लिए '.'; वाक्य सरल और छोटे रखें।
